messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads-up — month-end close is tomorrow EOD. I need final deferral schedules for annual contracts, accruals for metered usage (Mar 1–31), and any revenue schedule changes from the pricing experiment. Please reply with owners and ETA.
Ben (RevOps): I'll take annual contracts (sales-sourced). Will post deferred revenue schedule for 3 ACV deals (Acme, Nova, Skyline) by 4pm PT.
Carla (Billing): I own usage reconciliation. Quick Q — for accruals do we base on billed invoices or on a run-rate estimate? Last month we used billed; a few customers had lagging invoices.
Priya (Finance): Use billed invoices where available. For customers without invoices by close, use last 7-day run-rate * 1.05 to be conservative. Add a column "assumption" to the schedule.
Ethan (Revenue): There's an open dispute on AcmeCorp INV-6789 — they claim overage on tokens due to timestamp mismatch. They underpaid by ~$3,200. Should we book an allowance?
Priya (Finance): Yes, book an allowance for doubtful accounts for that line until dispute resolved. Use GL code AR-ALLOW-001 and tag the deferral row with "dispute: Acme".
Ben (RevOps): Posting preliminary deferral journal for the Acme annual contract (signed for $120,000, service period Apr 1–Mar 31 next year). Here's the suggested JE for initial deferral:
```
DR Cash 120,000 (or AR if not collected)
CR Revenue 0 (deferred)
CR Deferred Revenue 120,000 (DEFER_REV_4000)
```
Then monthly recognition: DR Deferred Revenue 10,000 
CR Revenue 10,000.
Carla (Billing): Pricing experiment note — the Edge-Launch promo issued $12,450 in credits across ~400 customers during Mar. How should we treat those for close? Marketing coupon vs contractual discount?
Ethan (Revenue): Per policy: marketing-issued one-off credits = contra-revenue unless tied to a contractual rebate. Spread over typical redemption period (30 days) if used over time; if all credits issued and consumed in the same period, recognize as reduction in revenue this month. For the Edge-Launch, we have redemption spread across Mar 10–Apr 9, so amortize as contra-revenue over that window.
Priya (Finance): Agreed. Please provide a small schedule: total credit $12,450, recognition by day/week, GL code CONTRA_REV_7001.
Ben (RevOps): Uploaded deferral schedule CSV to /finance/reports/deferrals_1713600000.csv — includes contract id, customer, total value, start_date, end_date, monthly_recognition, assumption.
rev-bot: Reminder (automated): Please upload revenue schedule CSV to /finance/reports before 17:00 PT for ingestion into the GL upload tool.
Carla (Billing): Usage accrual approach: for metered customers without invoices, I estimated accrual = runrate * 1.05. Top 5 accounts accrual total = $38,750. Details in the sheet.
Ethan (Revenue): For the disputed Acme amount, I'll create a contra-entry pending resolution:
```
DR Bad Debt Expense 3,200
CR AR 3,200
```
Mark as reversible when dispute resolves.
Priya (Finance): One more — cross-check deferred revenue schedules against CRM start dates. Last month we had 2 month-shift errors where start_date in CRM was off by 1 month and recognition skewed. Ben, can you run a quick diff?
Ben (RevOps): On it. Running diff now. If any mismatch > 7 days, we'll open FIX tickets and adjust journal before close.
Carla (Billing): Quick FYI — Stripe connector exported a duplicate invoice id for Nova (INV-7012 duplicate), I flagged and excluded it from accrual totals.
Priya (Finance): Perfect. Final checklist for tomorrow: 1) deferral schedules uploaded + assumptions column, 2) usage accruals with backup, 3) pricing-experiment credit schedule (contra-revenue), 4) flagged disputes & allowances, 5) GL codes documented for each JE.
Ethan (Revenue): I'll prepare a one-page memo for auditors describing treatment for Edge-Launch credits and Acme dispute. ETA 9am PT tomorrow.
Priya (Finance): Thanks everyone. If you can't hit the times above, escalate here or ping me 1:1. :thumbsup:
Ben (RevOps): Confirmed GL mapping: DEFER_REV_4000 for deferred revenue, CONTRA_REV_7001 for credits, AR-ALLOW-001 for allowances.
Carla (Billing): All schedules will be in /finance/reports. I'll add a short note on assumptions in the sheet.
rev-bot: Close reminder scheduled at 16:30 PT. Good luck! :rocket:
